bugs.item: C-R83-S-1280-RANGE-SHIFT (parked as RP-RANGE-1280; SRW-04 range selection / SRW-11B lane auto-fit)
bugs.regression: no — pre-existing since round 83 (parked observation), not a regression
steps: add synth mix to music at 0, stems pulse to stems at 2, soft impact to SFX at 4
select the stems clip, drag a body range 5→8 s on it
read the stems clip box before and after
bugs.expected: stems clip y and height unchanged within ±0.5 px (RP-RANGE-1280)
bugs.actual: during the drag (already at mid-drag) the whole workspace shrinks by 20 px (library 529→509, timeline scroller 386→366, detail panel top 615→595 with unchanged 36 px height, so ~20 px is added below the panel), lane auto-fit trims every lane 80→75 px, and the stems clip moves y 458→449, h 71→66 (dy −9, dh −5). It stays shifted after release. 1440×900: no shift (0/0). Ruling input: no mis-hit — the range lands on the intended clip (5–8; and 3–6 even when the drag starts at 93 % of the clip height, where the pointer ends over the SFX lane at release), the selection stays on stems, and the next click on the SFX header selects SFX. So by B's pre-stated ruling this is Low → deferred_low_polish

bugs.item: SRW-14 / T12 stage 4b (Waveform Zoom select in the grid control; gate-121 reviewer suggestion 7, parked as RP-HEADER-WIDTH)
bugs.regression: no — new observation on the round-121 control (first time this state was measured); not a regression of an earlier pass
steps: type 90 in the BPM field, Enter (the division select now also lists 1 ტაქტი … 1/32 and grows to 85 px)
optionally: division 1 ტაქტი, Snap on, Env on, Waveform Zoom 8×

bugs.expected: grid control scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth, every control inside the 224 px sticky cell (RP-HEADER-WIDTH)
bugs.actual: scrollWidth 225 > clientWidth 223 from the moment BPM 90 is set (straight musical list, select 85 px); the Waveform Zoom select spans 485–513 px while the control ends at 512, so its right border is clipped by ~1 px (shots/RP-HEADER-WIDTH-1440-straight-grid-control.png). All four controls stay hit-testable (elementFromPoint), grid row 28 px, chrome rows [28,20,20,16] unchanged. With the triplet the row names (1/32T) the select is only 76 px and nothing overflows (0 px), so the triplet is not the widest state. Ruling: visible clipping, all controls operable → Low → deferred_low_polish
